test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Our maid will clean the house every Saturday from today onwards.

options.text: The house shall be cleaned by our maid every Saturday from today onwards
The house will be cleaned by our maid every Saturday from today onwards.
The house will have been cleaned by our maid every Saturday from today onwards.
The house will be cleaning by our maid every Saturday from today onwards.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The house will be cleaned by our maid every Saturday from today onwards."****
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject is "our maid" **and the object is** "the house" **in the active voice.
 
• The subject is "the house" and the object is "our maid" in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: *The house will be cleaned by our maid every Saturday from today onwards*.
